title: Moment
description: One captured moment: what was heard and seen at a point in time. The unit of memory and of proof.

ts.description: When it happened (capture time, not storage time).

mode.description: The mode active when it was captured: focus, student, life, assist or a custom mode's slug.

caption.description: What was seen, as a short caption.

snapshot_url.description: URL or repo-relative path of the stored snapshot.

video_url.description: URL of a stored video clip, capped at 10 seconds.

tags.description: Labels Cortex added, e.g. decision (FOC-5). Absent when there are none.

off_record.description: True if captured while off-the-record; such moments are not stored, so stored moments are always false unless kept by explicit user choice.
